allocate_LibrariesResource: create a LibrariesResource instance and call allocate to set the HF endpoint and disable download counts
release_LibrariesResource: call release on a LibrariesResource to restore the previous HF endpoint and verbosity settings
configure_datasets_cache: create a LibrariesResource with init_hf_datasets_cache to override the HF datasets cache directory
suppress_datasets_logs: call allocate on LibrariesResource to set the datasets library log level to critical only
review_LibrariesResource_allocate: review the LibrariesResource allocate method to understand how it configures the HF endpoint and download counts
